# Giorgi Khvichia

> The portfolio of Giorgi Khvichia, a full-stack software engineer in Tbilisi, Georgia. He builds whole products: web platforms, 3D experiences, AI tools and hardware. Founder of shemoqmedi.space.

## This site

- [Portfolio](https://khvichia.shemoqmedi.space/): the home page with his skills and stack, the sites he has built, a few photos, and how to reach him
- [CV, English (PDF)](https://khvichia.shemoqmedi.space/cv/Giorgi-Khvichia-CV.pdf): experience, projects, education, awards and technical skills
- [CV, Georgian (PDF)](https://khvichia.shemoqmedi.space/cv/Giorgi-Khvichia-CV-KA.pdf): the same CV in Georgian

## Case studies

- [Shemoqmedi, case study](https://khvichia.shemoqmedi.space/work/shemoqmedi): Website awards, made in Georgia: a stage for great websites and the people behind them. Recognizing great websites, and giving Georgian web design a stage beside them. Role: Founder, Product design, Full-stack engineering. Stage: Active development & community building.
- [Kencho Room, case study](https://khvichia.shemoqmedi.space/work/kencho-room): A furniture showroom designed to be explored, not just scrolled. An interactive room for a custom-furniture brand. Role: Creative developer, Interactive engineering. Stage: Client project, Live.
- [Kencho Group, case study](https://khvichia.shemoqmedi.space/work/kencho-group): A digital home for a custom-furniture studio. Giving a custom-furniture business a distinctive digital presence. Role: Full-stack / frontend implementation, End-to-end delivery. Stage: Client project, Delivered.
- [Kalami, case study](https://khvichia.shemoqmedi.space/work/kalami): Built in the classroom. Tested by the people learning in it. An educational platform shaped by real classroom needs. Role: Creator, Full-stack engineer, University lecturer. Stage: Active university pilot.

## Work

- [shemoqmedi.space](https://www.shemoqmedi.space/): web design awards
- [The Room by Kencho Group](https://room.kenchogroup.ge/): a 3D furniture room
- [Kencho Group](https://www.kenchogroup.ge/): a custom furniture studio
- [Kalami](https://www.kalami.space/): a learning platform for universities
